articulation.label: Letter A
articulation.alt: Letter A: /eɪ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.

cards.title: Letter B
sections: ball /bɔl/ · a round object for games
The letter name is /bi/. In ball, b starts with /b/: close both lips briefly, then release into the vowel. Do not add “uh” or use “bee” when blending. Hear the word in “This is a ball.”

articulation.label: car
articulation.alt: car: /k/ → /ɑ/ → /r/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: park
articulation.alt: park: /p/ → /ɑ/ → /r/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: bird
articulation.alt: bird: /b/ → /ɝ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: turn
articulation.alt: turn: /t/ → /ɝ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɝ/: Bunch the tongue for American r; no tip contact.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: banana
articulation.alt: banana: /b/ → /ə/ → /n/ → /æ/ → /n/ → /ə/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: hotel
articulation.alt: hotel: /h/ → /oʊ/ → /t/ → /ɛ/ → /l/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/o/: Start with a mid-back tongue and round lips.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: teacher
articulation.alt: teacher: /t/ → /i/ → /tʃ/ → /ɚ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/i/: High, front tongue; lips relaxed.
/tʃ/: Brief closure, then a narrow sh-like release.
/ɚ/: A lighter, unstressed r-colored vowel.

articulation.label: rag
articulation.alt: rag: /r/ → /æ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: fin
articulation.alt: fin: /f/ → /ɪ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /f/: Upper teeth lightly touch the lower lip.
/ɪ/: Front tongue, a little lower and relaxed.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: mug
articulation.alt: mug: /m/ → /ʌ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: peg
articulation.alt: peg: /p/ → /ɛ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.

/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.

articulation.label: pen

notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.

/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: ram
articulation.alt: ram: /r/ → /æ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: nod
articulation.alt: nod: /n/ → /ɑ/ → /d/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/ɑ/: Low back tongue; jaw open.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: tub
articulation.alt: tub: /t/ → /ʌ/ → /b/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/ʌ/: Tongue central; jaw comfortably open.
/b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: vet
articulation.alt: vet: /v/ → /ɛ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /v/: Upper teeth touch the lower lip; add voice.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
